core.title: Autumn Boat Jumble at Saltwick Marina
core.setting: Marina office manager at Saltwick Marina, a 120-berth boat harbour

events.text: Office rule: any single supplier order over £500 needs Rowan Pell's sign-off as finance lead before it is placed.
Office rule: once a contractor booking is confirmed, its date or start time may only be moved with that contractor's written agreement.
The committee confirmed the Autumn Boat Jumble for Saturday 17 October 2026 on the north quay, open to berth holders and the public from 09:00.
Fairway Catering quoted £18 per head for jumble day buffets, up to 80 guests, served from the north quay marquee.
Westcountry Marquees has a 9 by 18 metre marquee free for Saturday 17 October 2026 at £640, with erection on the north quay on Friday 16 October.
Hal Vose confirmed the marina safety boat and a two-person crew are available on Saturday 17 October 2026 from 08:00 to 16:00.
Booked the 9 by 18 metre marquee from Westcountry Marquees for Saturday 17 October 2026 on the north quay at £640, erection on Friday 16 October; Rowan Pell signed off the spend as it is over £500.
Ordered the Fairway Catering buffet for the Boat Jumble at 56 guests times £18 per head, £1008 in total, for Saturday 17 October 2026; Rowan Pell signed off the order as it is over £500.
Booked the marina safety boat with Hal Vose's two-person crew for Saturday 17 October 2026, 08:00 to 16:00, to cover the Boat Jumble.
Penwith Fuels quoted £1.42 per litre for a 2,000 litre winter diesel delivery to the marina fuel berth, price held until the end of October 2026.
Tamar Fuels' standing supply agreement with Saltwick Marina holds diesel at £1.36 per litre for scheduled fuel berth deliveries through 2026.
Ordered 1,800 litres of diesel for the fuel berth from Tamar Fuels under the standing agreement at £1.36 per litre for delivery on 12 October 2026; Rowan Pell signed off the £2448 spend.
Sent berth holders a notice that the Autumn Boat Jumble takes place on the north quay on Saturday 17 October 2026 and the quay will be busy from 08:00.
Scheduled the closure of Pontoon C on Friday 16 October 2026 so Westcountry Marquees can erect the jumble marquee beside the north quay.
Ordered 20 bags of ice and 200 reusable glasses from Harbourside Supplies for the Boat Jumble at £220; under the £500 threshold so no finance sign-off was needed.
Assigned marina staff Kerri Bunt and Olly Pascoe to the jumble entrance gate on Saturday 17 October 2026, 08:30 to 15:30.
Spoke with the crane engineer about dates for the winter lift-out programme; nothing booked yet.
The sailing club cancelled its dinghy race planned for 25 July 2026 because of the forecast gale.
From 1 September 2026 the chandlery opens 08:30 to 17:00 on weekdays and 09:00 to 13:00 on Saturdays.
Beacon Marine Insurance sent the routine annual schedule for the marina's public liability cover, unchanged from last year.
Fairway Catering confirmed their van can use the north quay power point and the marina workshop sink for water on jumble day.
The committee's summer review noted that visitor moorings income was up and asked for a report on winter berth occupancy by November.
Penwith Fuels is still holding its quote of £1.42 per litre for Saltwick's 2,000 litre winter diesel delivery if the marina wants to take it up.
Quayline Oils offered autumn diesel at £1.41 per litre for deliveries over 1,500 litres to Cornish marinas this season.
Office note: Penwith's winter diesel quote of £1.42 per litre for 2,000 litres is still on file for a decision later in the autumn.
Apologies for the mix-up on our side: the correct price on our winter diesel quote for Saltwick Marina is £1.39 per litre for 2,000 litres, not £1.42; the quote still stands until the end of October.
Jumble planning meeting: marquee, 56-cover buffet, safety boat and gate rota all confirmed for Saturday 17 October 2026; signage to go up from 12 October.
Westcountry Marquees' erection crew will arrive at the north quay at 08:00 on Friday 16 October 2026 to put up the jumble marquee.
Fairway Catering asked Saltwick Marina to send the final jumble headcount by Wednesday 7 October 2026; kitchen access arrangements are all fine.
Reminded berth holders that Pontoon C will be closed on Friday 16 October 2026 for marquee erection ahead of the Boat Jumble.
To-do: send Fairway Catering the final headcount for the Boat Jumble buffet by Wednesday 7 October 2026.
Hal Vose ran the safety boat radio check ahead of jumble day; both handheld sets working.
Reminded Kerri Bunt and Olly Pascoe they are on the jumble entrance gate on Saturday 17 October 2026 from 08:30.
